detail.longDescription: When you want to get more done and have more impact at work, automation can help. Zapier helps you turn your tools into powerful processes. Whether you need to automate a simple task or build an entire automated system, you can do it all on Zapier. We've collected some of the best Zapier examples across different industries and roles, so you can find something to help you get more done, no matter what you do at work.
